feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated. The best raced design is iteration 2 (kp 1.4, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.0, score 625.2). It finished 20 of 20 oval runs, finished 17 of 20 s-bend runs with steering_oscillation 0.42, and failed every slalom run at progress 0.17 with max_error near 0.0615 m. Iteration 3 (kp 1.6, score 541.7) lowered s-bend finishes to 9 of 20 and left the slalom unchanged, so kp above 1.4 is not the fix. This candidate returns to the iteration 2 controller and changes only kd, from 0.4 to 0.5, with geometry and base_speed unchanged. Any change in result therefore comes from kd. The s-bend oscillation of 0.42 is the clearest weakness in the best design, and it sits well above the 0.15 level. The off-track limit check in the rationale is correct: with body_width 0.12 the limit is 0.06 m, and widening the body cannot lift it above 0.0575 m, so the body cannot be used to rescue the slalom. The change is small, valid and reversible, so approve it and read the race as follows. If s-bend steering_oscillation falls and s-bend finishes rise toward 18 to 20 of 20 while the oval stays a full finish, keep kd at 0.5 and test kd 0.6 next. If the oval slows or stops finishing, return kd to 0.4. If the slalom still ends off_track at max_error near 0.06 with low oscillation, the limit is sensor reach or speed through the slalom's sharp turns rather than damping, so the next change should move the sensors forward (y about 0.07) or lower base_speed to about 0.9 only if s-bend completion_time stays under 3 s.
requested_changes: Keep kp 1.4 and base_speed 1.0 fixed and set kd to 0.5. Iteration 2 (kd 0.4) left s-bend steering_oscillation at 0.42, well above the 0.15 level, and iteration 3 showed that raising kp to 1.6 cut s-bend finishes from 17 to 9 of 20.

If s-bend finishes rise and oscillation falls with the oval still finishing 20 of 20, test kd 0.6 next. If the oval slows past about 2.3 s or stops finishing, return kd to 0.4 and treat damping as exhausted.

If the slalom still ends off_track at max_error near 0.06 m with low oscillation, move the two outer sensors forward to y 0.07 m for more lead, keeping the x positions, or lower base_speed to about 0.9 only if the s-bend completion_time stays under 3 s. Iteration 2 showed the slalom at 0.17 progress, which kp changes from 1.2 to 1.6 did not move.
